author: (Gmelin, 1789)

note.en: A pale tern with a short thick black bill that hawks insects and picks crabs from sand and marsh; a rare winter or passage visitor here with a handful of records.
note.es: Un charrán pálido de pico corto, grueso y negro que caza insectos y toma cangrejos de la arena y los humedales; es un visitante raro de invierno o de paso aquí, con un puñado de registros.

evidence: iNaturalist: 3 research-grade records in the region

sources.t: iNaturalist taxon page and regional observations
Garrigues & Dean, The Birds of Costa Rica: A Field Guide (2nd ed., 2014), status and range

recWhy: Three iNaturalist records in the region, sites not stated.

marks.en: Stocky tern with a short, thick black bill, black cap, pale grey back and white underside.
marks.es: Charrán robusto con pico negro corto y grueso, gorra negra, dorso gris pálido y vientre blanco.
